description: Get one React Native / Expo component’s public documentation: description, actual props and usage, dependencies, supported platforms, price, preview, and access. Use this to check its customization options before integration. Demo styling is one example; available color, font, asset, text, and layout controls differ by component. Read the returned README to distinguish supported props from changes that require editing source, and to understand any use-case-specific data model. Returns the compatibility matrix and selected delivery revision. expo_sdk defaults to the installed Expo version, then package.json, then the catalog current SDK. Do not infer prop names from the preview.

expo_sdk.description: Expo SDK release to inspect. Defaults to the detected project SDK, or the catalog current SDK.
